verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product or platform, so connecting an agent via an official MCP server is a category error for this kind of offering. The firm's internal use of AI tools does not amount to shipping an MCP server, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
